control.description: A test file deliberately placed outside every CI selector must appear in the orphan list; empty orphan list with this fixture means the mapper is not discriminating.

cwd=. argv=python3 -m pytest --collect-only -q hooks/ --import-mode=importlib --ignore hooks/memory-guard/test_scan.py --ignore hooks/cmd-rewrite
